question: When production selective DFS has already justified a score-directed backtrack, is the nearest admissible causal sibling also the most useful rewind point available at that instant?

relationship_to_production.current_choice: The first eligible watch encountered while walking from the active node toward the root: the nearest live, mature, non-pressured causal sibling whose inherited axis-loss regret reaches the production threshold.
unchanged: the production branch-regret trigger threshold and maturity
bounded equal-depth catch-up and strict winner selection
repair allocation, terminal registration, and acceptance
relationship_to_production.scope: This is a general selective-DFS branch-selection question. It is not a repair-incumbent signal and it does not require a completed incumbent.

instrument.behavior: Production selective-axis-regret catch-up; traversal remains nearest-first.
instrument.choice_set: Every watch on the active lineage that independently satisfies the exact production trigger and admission rules at the same decision instant, ordered nearest first.

counterfactual_categorical_policies.maximum_regret_per_estimated_work: largest axis-loss delta times deadline margin; within one event this is proportional to regret divided by conservative suffix-cost estimate

trust: the first recorded choice must exactly equal the sibling production selected
event-derived choice totals, multiple-choice events, and maximum breadth must equal compile aggregates
candidate and reference tracks, scores, and validity must match exactly
counterfactual policies select labels only; they do not replay traversal or estimate score

predeclared_map.selection_rule: Build one live maximum-regret-per-estimated-work arm only if it differs from nearest-first on at least 20 mapped events spanning at least four runs and two sources. The rule uses action-set breadth only, never output score. If it fails, close this branch-point policy without a live run.
predeclared_map.policy_rationale: Among already-triggered, equally admissible causal siblings, value-per-estimated-work directly balances the inherited score defect that could be changed against the conservative suffix work needed to test it. Stable ties retain nearest-first.
predeclared_map.next_step_if_selected: Implement a single environment-selected live arm that changes only the selected rewind watch, validate exact policy choice and accounting, then use fresh seeds in a focused 750k screen before considering canonical evaluation.
predeclared_map.non_claim: This behavior-neutral map establishes whether a meaningfully different action set exists. It cannot establish score direction, estimate a headline, or authorize promotion, canonical evaluation, or a multi-budget sweep.

result.decision: closed: maximum regret per estimated work differs on only four events in three runs, below the predeclared 20-event and four-run breadth gate. No live arm, confirmation, canonical evaluation, or multi-budget sweep follows.
result.interpretation: Multiple older causal siblings often remain nominally admissible, but nearest-first is strongly aligned with both conservative suffix cost and regret-per-work. The next study should change the backtrack signal or work disposition, not tune this branch-point ranking.
